details.description:
Fevicol MR White Adhesive is a polysynthetic resin adhesive. It is a synthetic white adhesive used to stick paper, cardboard, thermocol, fabrics, etc. It is also used in handicraft activities like doll making, shell crafts and school projects. It can be utilised in bonding different materials, where one of the surfaces to be bonded has to be porous. Fevicol strongly binds wood, plywood, laminate, veneers, MDF, boards and cork, etc. It is also utilised in sports goods manufacturing and bookbinding.
Universal craft glue is ideal for pasting materials from papers, candy sticks, corrugated sheets, to heavy craft accessories and making slime. Classic white glue formula that becomes invisible when dry gives a clean finish to project work/article. Easily peels away from hands and clothes for quick cleanup.

details.description: Pidilite's All Fix Clear & Non-Staining All Purpose Adhesive is a versatile and reliable solution for a wide range of bonding needs. This transparent, synthetic liquid adhesive is perfect for craft projects and general household fixes, offering a strong and durable bond that works on materials like pearls, precious stones, plastics, glass, metal, and wood. The quick-drying formula allows for efficient application, with the adhesive starting to work just 15 minutes after application and fully drying overnight. Waterproof and non-staining, this multifunctional adhesive is the ideal choice for a variety of household and craft projects, thanks to its resilience, ease of use, and affordable price point. Whether you're repairing, crafting, or simply looking for a reliable all-purpose adhesive, Pidilite's All Fix is the perfect solution.

Fevicol Fabric Fix provides strong multi-substrate adhesion for fabric decoration and craft projects. It is ideal for attaching appliques such as shells, sequins, beads, mirrors, and other embellishments commonly used in creative designs. Its reliable bond strength helps keep decorative materials securely fixed to fabric.
The adhesive is wash-proof, ensuring that the materials remain in place even after washing, thanks to its long-lasting strength. Unlike many other fabric adhesives, Fevicol Fabric Fix does not leave stains or make the fabric stiff. It creates a flexible bond, allowing the fabric to retain its natural softness and movement. It also dries quickly, making it a convenient choice for neat and efficient fabric crafting.

Fevicol Green offers strong and dependable adhesion across a wide range of crafting materials. Its bonding performance is comparable to Fevicol MR on commonly used decorative substrates such as shells, sequins, beads, mirrors, foam and paper-based appliqués, making it suitable for creative art and craft projects.
Designed with sustainability in mind, Fevicol Green helps users craft with both confidence and care. Its formulation is made using 98% natural ingredients, making it a gentler choice for the planet. The packaging is produced from 100% recyclable material, further supporting eco-conscious use. This clear and transparent adhesive also provides fast grab and quick drying for neat, convenient and efficient application.

Introducing Fevicol Glue Drops - the ultimate multi-purpose adhesive solution that bonds instantly without any mess or stains. Crafted with a unique formula, these non-messy glue drops allow you to effortlessly stick a variety of materials, from photos on walls to jewellery pieces. Ideal for a wide range of creative projects, including art and craft, scrapbooking, and card making, Fevicol Glue Drops offer a quick and easy application with an instant bond. Enjoy the convenience of a stain-free finish and the versatility to tackle a multitude of tasks, from commercial uses to personal DIY projects. Experience the power of Fevicol Glue Drops and elevate your creative endeavours with this innovative, user-friendly adhesive.

The Fevicol Glue Drops Party Pack contains 96 convenient glue drops, perfect for creating stunning and personalised party decorations. This unique solution allows you to stick items instantly without leaving any stains - simply peel, apply and stick. It enables you to fix party décor effortlessly with no mess or residue, ensuring a clean and festive setup every time. Ideal for quick fixes and adding creative touches to decorations and party favours, the compact pack is easy to use and makes your decoration process smooth and hassle-free.

Fevicol Glue Drops are non-messy double-sided adhesives. Just choose what you want to stick and use one of these glue drops. These glue drops form an instant and strong bond and are perfect for various crafts, hobbies, creating 3D models, etc. Double-sided glue drops for sticking paper and papercrafts material.

Fevicol Glue Tac is a versatile and reusable adhesive that offers a unique blend of precision and ease of use. Designed for a variety of creative and practical applications, this non-toxic formulation is perfect for crafters of all ages. Stick, hold, and hang small objects on virtually any surface, from walls and furniture to windows and desks. Removable without leaving any stains or marks, Glue Tac is an ideal alternative to nails and tapes for hanging light items. Easily tear the 90 pieces to the desired size and use it to decorate, organise, and secure a wide range of items, from canvases and drawings to tablecloths and wobbly tables. With its exceptional adhesion and removability, Fevicol Glue Tac is a must-have for any crafter's toolkit.

details.description: Pidilite Adhesive Shoe Fix is the ultimate solution for repairing and restoring your beloved footwear. This fast-setting, no-drip adhesive forms a strong, water-resistant, and flexible bond that can securely fix sports shoes, leather shoes, and sandals without creating a mess. Crafted with versatility in mind, the adhesive works seamlessly with a variety of materials, including rubber, PVC, PU, EVA, canvas, and leather. Simply apply and let it dry for an hour to enjoy long-lasting, effective repairs. Whether you're looking to mend a worn sole or reattach a loose strap, this Fevicol Shoe Fix adhesive is the reliable and convenient choice for keeping your footwear in top condition.

Fevicol Shoefix is a shoe repair adhesive that provides a fast, waterproof, and durable bonding solution for various shoe materials, including leather, rubber, and synthetic materials. It is designed to tackle a wide range of shoe-related issues such as sole separation, insole detachment, heel breakage, toe tear, embellishment detachment, and straps breakage. The adhesive ensures a firm bond that stands the test of time and remains intact through various activities and terrains.
